## Review and scope boundary

Skill-orchestrator-pro/skill-router reused planning, Supabase, TDD and verification. Council-review was **one assistant simulating security, continuity and execution perspectives**, with no independent reviewer or agent. Security/skeptical review favored source-bound exact ceilings and keeping real-user/sensitive read-all paths absent. Continuity favored independently verified custody over a super-admin label. Execution favored a coherent read/preflight transaction boundary before opening permission mutations. A direct generic role editor using roles.manage as an unlimited ceiling was the credible alternative and was rejected: it could activate sensitive scope or strand custodian/delegation authority.

No public role mutation is exposed because its safety is a dependent transaction: immutable role revisions, assignment provenance/invalidation across existing authority readers, verified replacement enrollment, continuity/version/retry and audit/outbox must be implemented and verified together. The existing role/assignment table write grants remain closed. This is a resumable local checkpoint, not a completed P34 or an external-only blocker.

Manual review checked actor derivation, scope catalog, empty search paths/execute revocation, raw RLS, current source/recipient roles/memberships/deployments, independent same-term attestation, no-self-change/custodian checks, own-only explanations, unreadable/missing work equivalence and synthetic input whitelist. Preflight does not substitute for mutation authorization, lineage or verified provider sessions.
